Feature: Switches are set while driving
Expected: After Start, new switch changes have been added to the history of 'Weichen', i.e. the app has set switches via the Switch Server while the trains were driving

After stopping, resetting, setting Bahn 1 to Haltestelle 1 -> Haltestelle 2 and Bahn 2 to Haltestelle 2 -> Haltestelle 1 and clicking Start, the trains drove (Bahn 2 at 120) but after two 30-second waits the Weichen history still showed the same 6 entries (applied: 6, ignored: 0, rejected: 0); all switches stayed at 1. No switch changes were sent while driving.

report:
Feature: Start makes the locomotives drive
Expected: Both histories contain entries with a speed higher than the calibration speed (the train's normal speed), forward or backward; at least one train currently has a speed greater than 0; apart from the calibration speed, each train uses only one non-zero speed value
Observed failure: Stopped, reset routes, set Bahn 1 and Bahn 2 to Haltestelle 1 and Haltestelle 2, clicked Start, waited 15 s and opened the mock server console. Both histories contain 120 (above calibration speed 60) as the only driving speed, but the Speed column showed 0 for both Bahn 1 and Bahn 2; in the app Bahn 2 was 'fährt zu Haltestelle 1' at 0 (0 cm/s). A re-read 5 s later showed new 120->0 entries for both but both speeds again 0.
Steps completed before failure: 11

Feature: Trains never occupy the same place
Expected: In none of the screenshots do the markers of 'Bahn 1' and 'Bahn 2' overlap or stand on the same track section; one train waits or evades while the other passes
Observed failure: Bahn 1 stops Haltestelle 1 (A), Haltestelle 2 (B); Bahn 2 stops B, A; Start. Screenshots at ~8, 16, 18 s (budget exhausted before the 4th). Screenshot 3: Bahn 2 stands at the Kalibrierpunkt (status 'fährt zu Haltestelle 2') while Bahn 1 is at Weiche 2 'fährt zu Kalibrierpunkt', entering the dead-end spur where Bahn 2 stands. Markers did not overlap, but both trains are on/entering the same dead-end section.
Steps completed before failure: 11
